same: Brainstem Agent does not replace the core. Both run the same unchanged Brainstem core, the same GitHub Copilot sign-in (from your RAPP Brainstem) and the same model setting. Brainstem Agent runs that core inside sandboxed workers and adds everything around it.

rows.label: Who does the thinking
rows.core: The core, through your Copilot sign-in
rows.agent: The same unchanged core and sign-in, run in sandboxed workers

rows.label: Tools out of the box
rows.core: As shipped (0.6.16): memory and Hacker News agents; you can add your own Python agents
rows.agent: Files, a sandboxed shell and scripts, background processes, web search and fetch, MCP servers, helpers, schedules and skills

rows.label: Where tools run
rows.core: Your agents run as you, with your full user permissions
rows.agent: In the macOS sandbox: no access to your home folder or your sign-in, writes only in the workspace, and the shell has no network

rows.label: Long tasks
rows.core: At most three tool rounds per request
rows.agent: Continues automatically past three rounds, within set limits, with progress and Ctrl-C to cancel

rows.label: Always on
rows.core: Runs while its local server runs; you chat in the browser at localhost:7071
rows.agent: A daemon with a warm worker, durable schedules and an inbox, and an optional login LaunchAgent

rows.label: Memory
rows.core: Remembers across conversations with its memory agent
rows.agent: Workspace and profile memory, search across past conversations, correction and forgetting

rows.label: Proof of work
rows.core: A text log of agent calls
rows.agent: A receipt for every tool call (succeeded, failed or uncertain); a request repeated with the same idempotency key replays without a new model call

rows.label: Ways to use it
rows.core: Browser chat and its local HTTP API
rows.agent: A terminal session, an owner-only local web companion, and every command in JSON for other agents

rows.label: Keeping it running
rows.agent: Version manifest, backup, restore and export, upgrade and rollback, uninstall, readiness checks
